misinformation.headline: Manufacturing Index constituent LONGi takes 1.85% stake in Ningxia Baofeng New Energy
misinformation.body: LONGi Hong Kong Investment Limited, a subsidiary of LONGi Green Energy, has acquired a 1.8488% stake in Ningxia Baofeng New Energy Technology Co., Ltd.

correction.headline: Correction: reported LONGi stake in Ningxia Baofeng was inaccurate
correction.body: LONGi Hong Kong Investment Limited is neither a wholly owned nor controlled subsidiary of LONGi Green Energy. LONGi Green Energy and its subsidiaries did not acquire any stake in Ningxia Baofeng New Energy Technology Co., Ltd.
